parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description:
If the ETag specified in the request matches the ETag value of the object, the object and 200 OK are returned. Otherwise, 412 Precondition Failed is returned.

The ETag value of an object is used to check data integrity of the object. This parameter is empty by default.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time on which the function is invoked. The format of the value is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID of the invocation request of Function Compute.
